stop_condition: every AC of the corrected rqer fix spec (AC-1..AC-6) is traced to a passing paired check, and no high-severity finding remains in the review-artifact write/record/approve path

findings.evidence: Drove the SHIPPED driver (stub MCP server, isolated fixture, worktree at 9488c69+dirty) with a directory pre-placed at the derived path docs/reviews/dirprobe-r1.json: driver exited 0, printed the canonical path on stdout, and the artifact bytes landed INSIDE the directory as dirprobe-r1.json.tmp.<pid> — no file at the printed path. Plain-shell control: mv <file> <existing-dir> returns rc=0 on this platform (Darwin 25.3.0), so the checked-mv cannot fire for this shape.
findings.description: The CHECKED-mv comment claims the reproduced pre-existing-directory silent-drop shape is closed (discarded mv exit status ... so a target that pre-existed as a directory ... Checked now). mv into an existing directory SUCCEEDS, so checking its exit status closes only the disk-full/permission arms; the directory shape still prints a path and exits 0 with the paid Sol artifact stranded. qa-gate.sh review-record refuses artifact_path_is_directory downstream (fail closed for the record), but the driver misreports success in exactly the shape its own comment declares fixed. Fix: add the -d refusal or a [ -f ART_FILE ] post-check (the audit recipe named both) and correct the comment; the completion record decisions text (a full disk or a permissions error) is the accurate scope.

The fkm.3 lesson ledger records this defect class (comment crediting the wrong mechanism) shipping a live hole. findings.evidence: Two leftover echo DEBUG A0 lines to stderr; the second pipes a Stop payload through the fixture verify-before-stop.sh UNASSERTED before A0 asserts. On the expected ALLOW path that unasserted run truncates the tracker and clears current-task, so the asserted stop_decision that follows measures the post-release trivial-allow arm, not the matching-approval-releases arm its label claims.
findings.description: Shipped debug scaffolding that changes what the control measures (discriminating power survives indirectly, since a BLOCK would persist state and still fail the assert). Delete both lines and re-run the spec.

findings.evidence: cmd_review_record with --file in the repo-relative spelling reads the artifact via cat -- <relative> (CWD-relative) for validation and grammar extraction, but hashes the absolute $derived; with CWD != PROJECT_DIR and files at both spellings, the validated/extracted bytes and the hashed bytes diverge.
findings.description: Self-inflicted-only edge (both files authored by the same actor; no privilege boundary), but the record verdict fields can describe different bytes than artifact_hash names. Resolve input_path against PROJECT_DIR before reading, or read raw from $derived after the derivation check.
